info.title: Orma
info.summary: Read-only credit readings of XRP Ledger lending vaults (XLS-65, XLS-66) on Devnet.
info.description: Every amount is a decimal string, in drops for an XRP vault: never parse one into a float. Every 200 carries serverTime and ledgerIndex. The prose reference, with captures, is documentation/pages/http-api.mdx. Nothing here signs or moves anything.

parameters.description: pledge (a loan against the shares) or buy (an OTC purchase).

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Step 21: the loan's currency, XRP (the default) or USD, the Devnet test dollar that stands in for RLUSD; USD with op=pledge only, else 400 BAD_OP; 503 NOT_CONFIGURED when this server lends no test dollar; 409 PRICE_UNAVAILABLE when the oracle documents of the terms give no usable XRP/USD price at the ticket's ledger. The collateral stays shares of XRP vaults.

units.name: units
units.description: Value a pledge of this many share units.

navNaive.description: Reported unit value: assets over units.

navCorrect.description: Held unit value: assets net of recognised loss over units.

NavDocument.description: orma.nav/1. Permanent: fields may be added, none renamed, retyped or removed.

scale.description: The vault's Scale: units per whole share is 10^scale.

Freshness.description: How old this facility's own reading is: a failed read keeps the last good one.

ShareStatus.description: The attestation status of a share.

Figure.description: A figure with its closed formula and its inputs, each read at one ledger. value is a decimal string.

items.description: One input, read at the ledger of the document.

Ticket.description: orma.ticket/1: computed on demand, never stored.

statement.description: The manager's statement (DECLARED) and its consistency with the ledger (REAL).

usd.description: Step 21, a loan in the test dollar (asset=USD): loanAsset (the label 'test dollar, stands in for RLUSD (Devnet)'), requestedUsd, collateralHeldUsd, ltvHeldBps in dollars, the XRP/USD price (REAL: the median of the terms' fresh XLS-47 oracle documents read at the ticket's ledger, each source with its price and age, the spread, the ledger's get_aggregate_price), the terms and the collateral line. On such a ticket figures carries maxLoanUsd, requestedUsd, collateralHeldUsd, ltvHeldUsd, lender1to1Usd and priceAge instead of maxLoan, requested, ltvHeld and lender1to1.

Mandate.description: orma.mandate/1, with its sister key deskPlan (never hashed).

deskPlan.description: plannedLoan, plannedBuy and vaults; step 21: usd, the dollar plan, loanAsset, vaultId, loanBrokerId and the UsdTerms, when this server lends the test dollar.

Change.description: orma.change/1: the field-by-field preview of a transaction, then its realisation.

RoleAction.description: A role action. previewing is internal and never served; approving is a request while its approve confirms.

Positions.description: Every desk loan at one ledger.

items.description: One desk loan. Step 21: currency (XRP or USD); principalOutstanding is the loan's PrincipalOutstanding in its asset (drops for XRP, dollars for USD); a USD position's ltvHeldBps is in dollars, its usage has maxSingleLoanUsd and maxPriceAgeSeconds, and it carries usd.

Decision.description: An entry of the chained decision log.

code.description: For refused. SUBMIT_UNCONFIRMED: the submission threw and a 60 s re-read did not find it; txHash is the hash sent.

FeedEvent.description: A credit event; STATEMENT is DECLARED, the six credit types are REAL.

entryHash.description: On a MARGIN_CALL_* event (step 20): the decision-log entry that records it.

UsdTerms.description: orma.usdterms/1 (step 21), DECLARED by the risk officer: the test dollar that stands in for RLUSD (Devnet), the XRP/USD price sources the desk trusts (XLS-47 Oracle documents, never a price: the median of the fresh ones, read at the ledger of each decision, the ledger's get_aggregate_price agreeing), the FX haircut and the cap of a dollar loan. hash = sha256 of the canonical terms without hash and anchorTx; anchorTx is an AccountSet of the risk officer whose Memo is orma.usdterms/1:<hash>. On Devnet the documents are relayed from exchange quotes by a test account of the desk; on mainnet the terms name independent oracle providers.

label.const: test dollar, stands in for RLUSD (Devnet)

MarginPolicy.description: orma.marginpolicy/1 (step 20): the risk officer's declared margin policy, hashed and anchored like the mandate.

MarginCall.description: A desk loan's margin call at one ledger (step 20), DECLARED: NONE, ISSUED, CURED or EXPIRED.

collateralValueUsd.description: Step 21, on a loan in the test dollar: the dollars missing at the declared reference price, less the haircut.

currency.description: Step 21: present on a loan in the test dollar, whose LTV is in dollars.

MarginCalls.description: GET /api/desk/margin-calls (step 20): the policy and one call per desk loan, at one ledger.

Universe.description: orma.universe/1: the known vaults and those seen live, read at one ledger; not an inventory of Devnet.

NycErrorCode.description: The error codes NYC routes add. BUSY (503, retryable) is also raised by /api/tickets and /api/desk/positions (four desk ledger walks at once) and by /api/feed/stream (100 open streams).
